layout.body:
Life Standard Tiles & Bathroom Fittings Supplier
56 Pasadina St.Los Angeles，CA
1-800-677-4477
Sales-Installation-Repairs
All types of patterns on residential structures
both interior and exterior will be customized !
We hereby submit specifications and estimates for the furnishing and installation of the following: Remove 95.68 square yards of tile. Install approximately 154.4 square yards of new tiles. Customers are responsible for determining the color, size, and design of tiles.
We hereby offer to provide labor and materials in compliance with the above specifications for the total amount of four thousand and one hundred thirty dollars ($ 4,130). 60% deposit required. Balance due upon completion. Completion is anticipated to be approximately two weeks after the day of initiation. Life Standard Tiles & Bathroom Fittings Supplier shall withdraw this proposal if not accepted within 20 days.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of this document?
questions.analysis: What is the purpose of this document? 原文依据：We hereby submit specifications and estimates… We hereby offer to provide labor and materials… 这份文件是报价单 / 正式报价，目的是提出一项服务报价。 A：为新产品做广告 → 错误 B：提出一项报价 / 要约 → 正确 C：宣布工作时间表 → 不是主要目的 D：确认订单 → 还没被接受，不是确认

questions.stem: What will Life Standard Tiles & Bathroom Fittings Supplier do?

options.B: Maintenance work on the existing tiles

questions.analysis: What will Life Standard Tiles & Bathroom Fittings Supplier do? 原文依据：Remove 95.68 square yards of tile. Install approximately 154.4 square yards of new tiles. 拆除旧瓷砖，安装新瓷砖 = 更换瓷砖。 A：给瓷砖涂不同颜色 → 错误 B：对现有瓷砖进行维护 → 错误 C：更换瓷砖 → 正确 D：安装新的浴室配件 → 文中只说安装瓷砖，未提配件

questions.stem: The word “compliance” is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: The word “compliance” is closest in meaning to 原文依据：provide labor and materials in compliance with the above specifications in compliance with = 按照、依照、符合accordance = 一致，符合in accordance with = 依照
